items.title: Eddie Bert interviewed by Monk Rowe, Danbury, Connecticut, November 20, 2001
items.q: he was on the show, and I knew he was coming

ctx.x: I could see Chubby doing that but probably not Oscar.

Yeah. But anyway he wanted to get me on the band, but that was in 1952 and I was trying to get established in New York and I couldn’t do that. Too bad. And another time, like I said, I was using Duke Jordan on piano and one of my daughters in the morning she said to me, “somebody, Duke called you and wanted to know something.” So I said, “well I don’t have any work right now,” you know, for Duke. She said, “no, not that Duke, the Duke you have all the records of.” I said, “you mean Duke Ellington?” She says,…
Right. What did you do for things like retirement and health insurance and all those things all those years?
